title: The workflow roles and personas, with the check-writer
situation: Decision 0046 named the role that writes checks before the build 'binder'; the central naming batch kept check-writer (binder cold-decoded at 1.41 of 4), and the rename was recorded only in 0046's acceptance reason, so 0046 read alone names a role that exists nowhere else.
decision: Generic holders: lead (owns a cut's realization; dispatches builder, check-writer, assayer, researcher; strongest tier, high), builder (one work package; edits only its outputs; strongest tier, medium), assayer (judges against fixed criteria; read-only; strongest tier, xhigh, with a second assayer on another model family), illustrator (examples cold from concepts only; another family, high), check-writer (writes the checks that bind examples before the build, specification by example's automating validation; another family, high). Personas over the architect: kino (film production and generative video; holds a film-production consumer's platform and production contexts; teaches a layman with provenance), nico (the corpus's concept space and the cold-decode oracle; holds the corpus and agents contexts; parsimony; peer density), mav (software system design for any software repository; holds that project's contexts; peer density).
consequences: Unchanged from 0046 except the name; realized by the catalog re-cut.
